[NDBG.12.1.1] `setBreakpoints` on a `.ds` source file accepts a
breakpoint on a `rule` declaration, an `after` line or an `on response`
line. One on a `rule` line stops only in that rule's firings; one on an
`after` or `on response` line stops only in that body's firings. Where it
stops:

- **in replay:** at the firing's record, before its first RHS action;
- **in a live session:** at the settled point after the pump, focused on the
  matching firing ([NDBG.10.1.1]). The engine refuses every call from inside a
  pump ([NDBG.1.2]), so no stop can fall inside one.

A breakpoint on any other line is `unverified` with message `"DS breakpoints
must be on rule, after or on response lines, or use ds/setFactBreakpoints
for fact-event breakpoints"`. When the session has no source lines (a `.dsc`
with no source spans and no `source` launch argument, [NDBG.9.3.1]), every
line breakpoint is `unverified` with message `"no source lines: give the
program's .ds"`.
